task.description: Implement ADP-04b per src/design/adp-04b-tenant-realm-binding.md. Update repository/service/API layers and tests needed for deterministic validation of default-tenant backfill, tenant creation validation boundaries, and realm-binding invariants with ADP-04a/OIDC-12. Run full backend validation required by BACKEND-DEV workflow before completing handoff.
